$comment: Master catalogue of learning materials for the LLM Materials collection. Every entry names a source, the licence it was verified under, the course application it feeds, the curriculum gap it closes, and the laboratory work it makes possible. 'verification' records how the identifier was checked and when. Licences are per-version: re-check the arXiv record or repository LICENSE file before redistributing anything.

verificationMethods.arxiv-abs: The citation_title meta tag was read from https://arxiv.org/abs/<id> and compared with the title recorded here.
verificationMethods.github-api: The SPDX licence identifier was read from https://api.github.com/repos/<owner>/<repo>.
verificationMethods.http-head: The URL was requested and the status code recorded.
verificationMethods.manual: The source is well known but could not be machine-checked from this environment (bot protection, TLS trust or rate limiting).

policy.redistribution: No application redistributes a textbook PDF, a paper PDF, a figure, a dataset or third-party code. Applications cite the source and link to it. The three course applications already in this collection set that rule: llm-foundations-lab releases course material under CC BY-NC 4.0 because its textbook is CC BY-NC 4.0, agentic-ai-academy releases under MIT because its textbook is CC0, and deep-learning-theory-explorer cites a copyrighted monograph without redistributing it.
policy.perVersion: An arXiv licence is attached to a specific submission. Cite a version, check that version, and re-check before publishing.
policy.attribution: Every application credits the authors on the landing page, in the footer, on the sources page and on every lesson that draws on the work.
